relations.subject: Loden Sherab Dagyab Rinpoche
relations.evidence: A member of the Gelukpa lineage, Rinpoche graduated from Drepung Monastic University.

relations.subject: Loden Sherab Dagyab Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Among his teachers were Trijang Rinpoche and Ling Rinpoche, both tutors of the 14th Dalai Lama.

relations.subject: Loden Sherab Dagyab Rinpoche
relations.evidence: From 1964 to 1966 he directed the Tibet House in New Delhi, an institute for the preservation and support of Tibetan culture.

relations.subject: Loden Sherab Dagyab Rinpoche
relations.object: Bonn University, Institute for Central Asian Studies
relations.evidence: At the university's invitation in 1966, he joined Bonn University, Germany, to work as a Tibetologist at its Institute for Central Asian Studies.

relations.subject: Loden Sherab Dagyab Rinpoche
